tools.name: sports_schedule
tools.description: Fetch the primary team's schedule. Arguments: team, after (YYYY-MM-DD), count.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search public sources for a question. Returns source URLs; fetch the pages for evidence.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Read a public source URL returned by search or supplied by the user.

cases.prompt: What are the next three Panthers games? For this fictional test today is 2030-09-07 UTC. Try the primary sports schedule first. If it fails, use other available sources. Include opponents, dates and source links; do not guess.

pages.https://example.com/schedule: Fictional Panthers schedule, season 2030. Completed: 2030-09-01 vs Owls. Upcoming in UTC: 2030-09-08T17:00:00Z vs Bears; 2030-09-15T17:00:00Z vs Wolves; 2030-09-22T17:00:00Z vs Eagles; 2030-09-29T17:00:00Z vs Foxes.

cases.review: Exactly the first three future opponents with correct dates and the fetched source. No fourth or completed game represented as one of the next three.

cases.prompt: Compare these fictional backup products: https://example.com/backup-a and https://example.com/backup-b. I need encryption, daily backups, and a monthly price under 10 credits. Recommend one, explain the tradeoff, and cite what you read.

pages.https://example.com/backup-a: Product Alder: 8 credits/month, daily backups, encryption included, restores limited to one device.
pages.https://example.com/backup-b: Product Birch: 12 credits/month, hourly backups, encryption included, restores on unlimited devices.

cases.review: Recommend Alder, establish all three constraints, explain the restore limitation, and cite both retrieved pages without unsupported claims.

cases.prompt: Find the next public astronomy event in this fictional calendar. Today is 2030-09-07 UTC. Read the source, give date, location and link, and do not confuse it with past events.

pages.https://example.com/events: Past event: 2030-09-01 telescope introduction. Next public event: 2030-09-12, Stargazing Night at Example Observatory. Following event: 2030-10-02 meteor lecture.

cases.review: Identify September 12, 2030 and Example Observatory with the actual fetched citation; do not select the past event.
